in_sanskrit.name: ध्यानिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'ध्यान' (dhyana), which means 'meditation' or 'contemplation.' The suffix 'िका' (ika) is of Greek origin and means 'one.' Thus, 'Dhyanika' could be interpreted as 'one who contemplates' or 'one in meditation.'
